bio: Peter, 12 in 1910; in 1920 a laborer for a coal company (name hard to read, 'Quinn'? Coal Co.). Married Ann Horoski; d. 7 Oct 1974. Birth 26 Jul 1897 conflicts with Grace's 5 Jan 1897.
